# `stop_streaming`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Image socket: stop the requesting client's live-view frame stream.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager binary image table (serves 4800/4804), handler @0x114020 (64-bit build), @0xa5058 (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, MainFileManager.stopStream; worker check CMyThread::IsRun; delStreamList(mutex, map<int,int>, id, iterator) |

Image-socket (4800/4804) method. Removes the calling connection from the shared stream-subscriber list under a lock and always replies with the text `done`. When no streaming connection remains, the streaming thread is stopped. READ. It mutates the shared subscriber list (operational bookkeeping) and may stop the streaming thread, but touches no hardware: MUTATOR / tier B. The 32-bit build matches (READ).

Side effects: Removes the client from the shared stream-subscriber list under a mutex; stops the streaming thread when no subscriber remains. Request-local reply. READ.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"stop_streaming"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read by the handler. The app sends no params member. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |
